mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it indicates aggressive monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates accelerating consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of early-cycle expansion periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals manufacturing contraction that precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
